task-sqs-receive-and-inspect-the-test-me.consoleGoal: Use the AWS Console to poll for the harmless test message, select it and inspect its visible details. Do not require the learner to copy or retain a receipt handle.
task-sqs-receive-and-inspect-the-test-me.futureCliGuidance: A future CLI path must retain the ReceiptHandle returned by receive-message for the later delete-message command.

task-sqs-delete-the-received-test-messag.consoleGoal: Use the AWS Console to select and delete the retrieved harmless test message. Do not require the learner to enter a receipt handle.
task-sqs-delete-the-received-test-messag.futureCliGuidance: A future CLI path must use the most recently returned ReceiptHandle with delete-message.

task-sqs-review-queue-deletion-effects-0.consoleGoal: Provide lifecycle-awareness checkboxes only: explain that queue deletion is permanent and that the temporary queue will be removed during Stage 8. Do not instruct the learner to delete the queue in Stage 6.
task-sqs-review-queue-deletion-effects-0.futureCliGuidance: A future CLI cleanup path may use delete-queue only in Stage 8.
task-sqs-review-queue-deletion-effects-0.stage8CleanupGuidance: Actual queue deletion belongs to Stage 8 cleanup and remains manual-only.

canonicalManualReviewFindings: The accepted sources do not yet provide the exact AWS Management Console Region-selection steps for eu-west-2.
An exact least-privilege policy must not be inferred. The learner must use an account or role already authorized for the required SQS Console actions.
Standard queues use at-least-once delivery and can occasionally return messages out of order; use one harmless test message and do not claim exactly-once or ordered delivery.
A Console-retrieved message is not deleted automatically and must be selected and deleted after verification.
FIFO-only requirements remain outside this standard-queue Follow Along.
Receipt-handle capture is preserved only for a future CLI path and is not required by the Console instructions.
Stage 6 provides queue lifecycle awareness only; actual manual queue deletion belongs to Stage 8 cleanup.
